## What changed?

Link the related Issue if there is one. Keep this PR focused.

## Evidence and scope

For catalog changes, link the exact primary evidence and license notice. Explain REA's specific role and any limitations. Disclose your affiliation. For website changes, describe the behavior before and after.

## Checks

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and did not include secrets or private data.
- [ ] Catalog descriptions do not overstate REA's role, functionality or license scope.
- [ ] I ran `npm run readme` when changing catalog data and included the generated README.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] For UI changes, I ran browser checks or clearly explained what remains untested.

## Not verified

List author-reported behavior, untested platforms or other uncertainties. Leave this section honest rather than treating a source review as a software audit.
